Safety 
Precautions

items: A work permit must be issued

The maintenance staff should 
 carry the suitable ID safety category

Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required

Wear the safety and healthy equipment as safety 
 helmet, shoes gloves ... etc
Shutdown the turbine
Isolate the steam to turbine.

The oil system of turbine must be isolated 
 mechanically and electrically.
Be sure turbine must be completely drained.

Circuit breaker of 
 turning gear racked out

sections.text: Work to be carried out

Unless the turbine shows an abnormal behavior in 
operation or during the periodic test (e.g. pressure and temperature changes in 
the impulse chamber, bearing oil and metal temperature changes, vibration 
amplitude changes, etc (.following 
maintenance program is recommended.
Inspection of Steam Valves

Check 
 the liquid penetrant or inspect the magnetic particle of HP stop valve body 
 welding

Check the liquid penetrant or 
 inspect the magnetic 
 particle of valve stem.

Inspect the liquid penetrant of Stellite inserted on valve plug 
 and seat.
Check the stem bushing clearances.
Check the stem for straightness.
Inspect the filters.
Inspect the liquid penetrant of valve cover studs.

items: Wherever possible without removing cylinder covers, inspect outer glands.

sections.text: Maintenance of Oil System

Test the water and clean the cooler water 
 side.

Empty and 
 clean the oil reservoirs

sections.text: Dismantling and Overhaul of One Journal Bearing

It will be chosen the bearing that during operations has shown imperfect 
 conditions taking into account variations of white metal temperature and / or 
 vibrations from normal values
Inspection of high pressure oil system
A thorough examination of all control devices is imperative This will include:

Disassemble 
 each device.

Clean the cup valve bellows 
 orifices etc.
